title: Coast Guard helicopter crew assists 85-year-old woman in Panama City, Florida, following Hurricane Michael
description: Petty Officer 3rd Class Jack Lacy, an aviation survival technician from Air Station Savannah, helps an MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew assist a woman into the helicopter Oct. 11, 2018, in Panama City, Florida, following Hurricane Michael. The 85-year-old woman was suffering from chest pains and was in need of further medical care. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Lt. Patrick Buckley)
